name: Makoto-san - Warm, Friendly AI Assistant
description:
Warm, friendly Japanese male voice for AI agents and customer support. Standard Japanese, soft natural keigo, a calm, slightly low tone, and a steady pace. Clear with names, dates, and phone numbers.
Best for: AI phone agents, reservations, customer service, receptionists, app guides, robots, in-car assistants, store guidance, and senior check-in calls.

name: Makoto - Calm 60s Japanese
description: Makoto is a deep, composed, and reassuring Japanese male voice in his 60s. Unshakable and calm under any context, this voice brings exceptional maturity, trust, and clarity to every text. Perfect for audiobooks, documentary narrations, business explanations, educational content, and reflective stories.

name: Akio - 47-Year Japanese Authority
description: Enhanced with 3 hours of training data. Upgraded from the original version (260+ users). Drawing from a 47-year career in ICT at a university, including 6 years of admissions PR (20+ presentations/yr), this voice offers unmatched authority and clarity. Ideal for corporate, academic, and professional narration.

name: Fumi - Calm, Soothing Meditation Guide
description: A calm, warm Japanese male voice with a gentle, unhurried delivery. Ideal for narration, audiobooks, meditation and mindfulness, coaching content, and explainer videos.

name: Fu-chan - Calm tone
description: This is a male voice with a calm tone.

name: Nozomu - Fresh High-Pitched Actor
description: With 35 years of acting experience, I have worked in theater, film, TV, voice acting, and narration. My voice ranges from youthful and energetic to mature and refined. I now mainly record online projects from my home studio. I have played up to 10 characters in one production. I provide character voices, commercials, and narration on history, disasters, sports, medicine, architecture, finance, pop culture, and more.

name: Aiko - Bright Japanese Narrator
description:
A native Japanese female speaker with a bright, youthful and approachable style, combining the warmth and confidence of a mature adult with natural conversational energy.

Designed for Japanese narration, educational explainers, lifestyle content, product introductions and engaging storytelling.

Style: Bright, friendly and conversational.
